description: This file is a React component written in TypeScript, defining the main page of a simple Todo web application. It handles user interactions such as adding, editing, and deleting todos, as well as displaying the list of todos with loading and error states.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component implementing the Todo application's interface and logic.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new todo when the user submits a new task.

methods.name: handleKeyDownAdd
methods.description: Handles key press events for the input to trigger add operation on Enter.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates the editing process for a specific todo item.

methods.name: confirmEdit
methods.description: Confirms and saves the edits made to a todo item.
